subject: Availability assertion + replay log package (RTO/RPO) - Orion Health
messages:
From: Sylvia Kent <sylvia.kent@orionhealth.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: legalops@orionhealth.com
Date: 2026-08-21T13:12:00Z
Subject: Availability assertion + replay logs request

Hi Laura,

As part of our SIG intake and an upcoming penetration audit, our compliance team needs an availability assertion and a package of replay logs that demonstrate RPO/RTO behaviour for the multi-region deployment you provisioned for us. Specifically: 1) an attestation that RTO <= 60 minutes for region failover, 2) RPO <= 15 minutes for KV cache and persistent storage under the last full-failover exercise, and 3) redacted replay logs from the 2026-08-18 drill showing warmstart timings for the KV cache.

Could you confirm what you can provide and an ETA? Ben from CyberTrust is copied for the logs format expectations.

Thanks,
Sylvia
Sylvia Kent
Director, Risk & Compliance
Orion Health
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sylvia Kent <sylvia.kent@orionhealth.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-21T15:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Availability assertion + replay logs request

Hi Sylvia — thanks for the clear ask. We can provide an availability assertion and the requested replay logs. Planned deliverables and timeline: 

- Availability assertion attestation (PDF) with RTO/RPO numbers and scope of the test: delivery by 2026-08-22 EOD (attached).
- Replay log package (redacted): a zipped package containing the chronology and replay artifacts from the 2026-08-18 tabletop + automated failover test: delivery by 2026-08-23 midday.
- A short technical memo describing KV warmstart timing, prefix cache behaviour, and any observed delta to RPO targets.

Marcus will include the log export and memo details; Irene will prepare the signed attestation once we have legal OK on the language. If Orion Legal needs any contract-level wording (SLA carve-outs, permitted testing windows), please flag now.

Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Security Programs | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415 555 0112
From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Sylvia Kent <sylvia.kent@orionhealth.com>
Cc: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-22T09:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Availability assertion + replay logs request - technical dump

Sylvia / Laura — the replay logs and technical memo are ready for packaging. Quick highlights from the 2026-08-18 run: 

- RTO observed: 42 minutes (promoted regional instance, rehydration, and service routing).
- RPO observed: 12 minutes max for persistent store; KV cache replication lag was ~4 minutes under test load (we record KV snapshots and replication offsets in the replay set).
- KV warmstart (full cold-to-ready for serving path): median 7.6s per shard; parallelized across 8 shards for customer workspace -> effective warm window ~1m10s for first-request readiness.
- Artifacts included: failover-trace.jsonl, kv-replication-offsets.csv, http-traffic-capture.pcap (redacted headers), and an ops timeline.csv.

I exported the logs redacting PII and any request payloads per our export policy. The ZIP contains a manifest with checksums and an index. Link/attachment: rpo_replay_logs_20260821.zip

If CyberTrust needs a different format, tell me and I can rerun the exporter.

-marcus
Marcus Lin
Principal Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Orion Health Legal <legalops@orionhealth.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sylvia Kent <sylvia.kent@orionhealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T12:33:00Z
Subject: Re: Availability assertion + replay logs request - attestation language

Laura / Marcus — thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple of contract/legal clarifications before we accept the attestation: 

1) Please add a sentence clarifying that the attestation applies to the specific deployed configuration (Orion Health account in eu-west-1 with active reserved capacity) and does not change the Master Services Agreement.
2) Add an explicit note about redaction: that exported logs were redacted to remove PHI/PII and that raw payloads are not being shared.

If you can include those two clauses I can sign / countersign on behalf of Orion. Otherwise Ben from CyberTrust has confirmed the logs format is acceptable for audit review.

- Orion Legal
From: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Orion Health Legal <legalops@orionhealth.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-22T16:50:00Z
Subject: Re: Availability assertion + replay logs request - attestation language

Hello — attached is the updated availability assertion attestation with the requested clarifying clauses added (see paragraph 2 and 5). I also embedded a short scope table listing the environment identifiers and the test window. Attachment: availability_assertion_attestation_signed.pdf (signed).

For the record: the attestation references the SOC 2 controls audited (CC6.2, CC7.1) and notes that the replay artifacts were produced with our standard redaction pipeline.

Irene Choi
Legal Counsel | Redwood Inference
From: Sylvia Kent <sylvia.kent@orionhealth.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: legalops@orionhealth.com, auditor@cybertrust.com
Date: 2026-08-23T20:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Availability assertion + replay logs request - confirmation

Laura / Irene / Marcus — got everything, thank you. We downloaded the ZIP and the signed attestation looks good to Legal with the added scope language. Ben has confirmed the logs load into their audit harness; they'll follow up if they need alternate formats.

Next steps for our side: internal acceptance from Compliance and a short 30-minute review call with CyberTrust (Tues 08/26) to walk the artifacts. I'll send a calendar invite.

Appreciate the quick support on this.

Best,
Sylvia
